presets.label: Wet area waterproofing before screed
observed: recessed puddle flange at floor waste
presets.post: Before a bathroom gets its tiles, we stop and photograph the bit you will never see: the membrane, the bond-breaker tape where wall meets floor, and the flange at the waste. The tape lets the joint move without tearing the membrane. That small step is why a shower stays dry for decades. #buildingright

presets.label: Timber frame, party wall
presets.scene: Timber frame at party wall junction
presets.post: Two rows of studs, staggered, with insulation woven between them. It looks like extra work because it is: it stops sound travelling through the wall between two homes. Quiet neighbours start at frame stage. #buildingright
